extensionDescription.message: Explore ChatGPT conversation branches and click messages to revisit them.

initialStatus.message: Open a ChatGPT conversation to view its branches.

draftStatus.message: This branch is a draft. Send a message to save it.

indexHint.message: Scan existing chats to find earlier branches.

legend.message: Green: current chat path · Dashed: branches · Drag empty space to pan

detailsHint.message: Click a message to revisit it.

settingsHint.message: Changes are saved automatically and applied to the side panel. Conversation text stays in its original language.

targetMissing.message: The message has not appeared on the page. Try again.

noVersions.message: This message has no version history control.

versionMissing.message: The requested version was not found.

messageMissing.message: This message is no longer in the conversation. Refresh the graph.

noVersionPath.message: This historical branch has no available version control.

conversationUnavailable.message: This conversation was deleted or is unavailable.

sessionLoad.message: Could not load the sign-in state ($1). Retry in ChatGPT, then refresh the graph.

conversationLoad.message: Could not load the conversation ($1). Try again.

cacheHint.message: Inspect stored conversations and scan progress. Clearing only removes current local data and preserves settings. Normal synchronization and scans may cache data again.

cacheEmpty.message: No cached conversations or scan progress.

cacheConfirm.message: Clear all local conversations and scan progress? Your settings and ChatGPT conversations will be preserved.
